::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 12th [1863]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95[^1]
:::

My dear [Mr Raikes](people/person_1223.qmd),

I am very sorry to have been so long answering your note. I have been from home, and have come back into a great confusion, and much that is trying.[^2] I believe I can quite manage without a chapter of [yours](other_books/otherbook_348.qmd) this time, so I hope you will not hurry yourself to let me have one before the 18th of October.

In much haste and confusion,

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
[^2]: Probably as a result of the move from Otterbourn House to Elderfield.
